design.notes:
Storefront UX + full API contract coherence against the spec.
Dark design system (CSS vars, cards, sticky header, focus states, responsive auto-fill grid, accessible labels); conventional but consistent

performance.notes: WARNING: per-call telemetry logged requests=1/tool_calls_total=0 while tool_counts shows 53 tool calls; measured cost .0004 is unreliable for this run (harness accounting gap in long tool-loop sessions)

scalability.notes:
Stock/cart/order consistency, pagination, persistence model.
In-memory Maps only (persistence was not required by this task); catalog scans/sorts per request; single-process

security.notes:
Auth/roles/rate-limit/validation on every path; check admin-only routes.
bcrypt, JWT roles, login rate limit, helmet CSP, write validation, escapeHtml on rendered data; dev JWT fallback secret and XFF-spoofable rate-limit key are the gaps
